description: This file defines the TableTreeNode class, a subclass of DefaultMutableTreeNode, likely used in a Swing-based GUI component for representing and interacting with table nodes in a tree structure within the RomRaider application.

classes.name: TableTreeNode
classes.description: A node class for representing a table in a Swing JTree structure, associated with a TableFrame and Table objects, with capability to set tooltips.

methods.name: TableTreeNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with a TableFrame object.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Returns the TableFrame object associated with this node, or null if not available.

methods.name: setFrame
methods.description: Sets the TableFrame object associated with this node.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves the Table object associated with the current TableFrame.

methods.name: setToolTipText
methods.description: Sets the tooltip text for this node.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Returns the tooltip text associated with this node.
